SELECT  CONCAT(p.first_name,' ',p.`last_name`) AS 'کارشناس',
        AVG(recordings.`agentScore`) AS 'متوسط امتیاز'
               FROM recordings
              JOIN `profiles` p
              ON `recordings`.`to_profile_id` = p.id

              WHERE date_created_ts >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')

                AND recordings.server_id = '101'

                 AND f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) = queue_id 

                AND to_profile_id IS NOT NULL
                and recordings.`agentScore` is not null
                
              GROUP BY to_agent
              order by 2
              LIMIT 5

SELECT tt.pause AS 'مدت توقف',
 CONCAT(p.first_name,' ',p.`last_name`)  AS 'کاربر',
 SUBSTR(`BASE64_DECODE`(aq.`PausedReason`),6)AS 'وضعیت'
FROM  `asterisk_members` aq
JOIN (
SELECT
  TIMEDIFF(NOW() , MAX(t.`time`)) AS pause,
  t.agent
FROM
  `agent_logs` t
  WHERE t.`time` >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
  AND t.`action_type` = 'pause'
  GROUP BY t.`agent`
   ) tt
  ON tt.agent =  SUBSTR(aq.NAME,7)
  JOIN `queues` q
  ON aq.`Queue` = q.`ext_number`
  JOIN agents a 
  ON a.agentid = SUBSTR(aq.NAME,7)
  JOIN `profiles` p 
  ON a.profile_id = p.id
  WHERE  aq.`paused` = 1
AND  f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) = q.`id`

SELECT CallerIDNum AS  "تماس از",
ConnectedLineNum AS "تماس به",
sec_to_time(WAIT) AS "انتظار",
POSITION AS "موقعیت"
 FROM asterisk_queue_entries t
 JOIN `queues` q
 ON t.`Queue` = q.`ext_number`
  WHERE f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) = q.`id`

SELECT
  oc.call_to AS "شماره داخلی",
  oc.answer_time AS "مدت زمان مکالمه",
  oc.to_profile AS "کاربر",
  incall.COUNT AS "تماس ورودی",
  outcall.COUNT AS "تماس خروجی",
  login.login AS "لاگین صف",
  oc.call_from AS "تماس"
FROM
  (SELECT
    CONCAT(p.first_name, ' ', p.`last_name`) AS "to_profile",
    t.call_to_exten as call_to,
    CONCAT(t.`call_from`, '=>') AS call_from,
    TIMEDIFF(NOW() , t.`answer_time`) AS answer_time,
    t.to_agent AS agentid
  FROM
    online_calls t
    JOIN agents a
      ON t.to_agent = a.agentid
    JOIN `profiles` p
      ON a.profile_id = p.id
  WHERE t.`call_direction` = 'IN'
    AND t.`status` = 'Talking'
    AND to_profile_id IS NOT NULL
     AND queue_id = f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue)
  ) oc
  LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT
      TIMEDIFF(NOW() , MAX(t.`time`)) AS login,
      t.`agent`
    FROM
      `agent_logs` t
      JOIN agents a
        ON t.`agent` = a.`agentid`
      JOIN `agents_queues` aq
        ON a.`id` = aq.`agent_id`
    WHERE t.`action_type` = 'login'
      AND aq.`login` = 1
      AND t.`time` >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
       AND queue_id = f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) 
    GROUP BY t.`agent`) login
    ON oc.agentid = login.agent
  LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT
      to_agent agentid,
      COUNT(recordings.id) AS COUNT
    FROM
      recordings
    WHERE date_created_ts >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
      AND recordings.server_id = '101'
       AND queue_id = f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) 
      AND to_profile_id IS NOT NULL
      AND to_agent IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY to_agent) incall
    ON oc.agentid = incall.agentid
  LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT
      from_agent agentid,
      COUNT(recordings.id) AS COUNT
    FROM
      recordings
    WHERE date_created_ts >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
      AND recordings.server_id = '101'
      AND call_direction = 'OUT'
      AND trunk_id IS NOT NULL
      AND from_profile_id IS NOT NULL
      AND from_agent IN (SELECT DISTINCT a.agentid FROM agents a WHERE a.id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM `agents_queues` aq WHERE  queue_id = f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue)))
    GROUP BY from_agent) outcall
    ON oc.agentid = outcall.agentid
    
    UNION 
    
    SELECT
  oc.call_from AS "شماره داخلی",
  oc.answer_time AS "مدت زمان مکالمه",
  oc.to_profile AS "کاربر",
  incall.COUNT AS "تماس ورودی",
  outcall.COUNT AS "تماس خروجی",
  login.login AS "لاگین صف",
  oc.call_from2 AS "تماس"
FROM
  (SELECT
    CONCAT(p.first_name, ' ', p.`last_name`) AS "to_profile",
    t.`call_from`,
    CONCAT(t.`call_to`, '<=') AS call_from2,
    TIMEDIFF(NOW() , t.`answer_time`) AS answer_time,
    t.from_agent AS agentid
  FROM
    online_calls t
    JOIN agents a
      ON t.from_agent = a.agentid
    JOIN `profiles` p
      ON a.profile_id = p.id
  WHERE t.`call_direction` = 'OUT'
    AND t.`status` = 'Talking'
    AND t.from_agent IN (SELECT DISTINCT a.agentid FROM agents a WHERE a.id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM `agents_queues` aq WHERE  queue_id = f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue)))
    AND from_profile_id IS NOT NULL
    
  ) oc
  LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT
      TIMEDIFF(NOW() , MAX(t.`time`)) AS login,
      t.`agent`
    FROM
      `agent_logs` t
      JOIN agents a
        ON t.`agent` = a.`agentid`
      JOIN `agents_queues` aq
        ON a.`id` = aq.`agent_id`
    WHERE t.`action_type` = 'login'
      AND aq.`login` = 1
      AND t.`time` >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
       AND queue_id = f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) 
    GROUP BY t.`agent`) login
    ON oc.agentid = login.agent
  LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT
      to_agent agentid,
      COUNT(recordings.id) AS COUNT
    FROM
      recordings
    WHERE date_created_ts >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
      AND recordings.server_id = '101'
       AND queue_id = f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) 
      AND to_profile_id IS NOT NULL
      AND to_agent IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY to_agent) incall
    ON oc.agentid = incall.agentid
  LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT
      from_agent agentid,
      COUNT(recordings.id) AS COUNT
    FROM
      recordings
    WHERE date_created_ts >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
      AND recordings.server_id = '101'
      AND call_direction = 'OUT'
      AND trunk_id IS NOT NULL
      AND from_profile_id IS NOT NULL
      AND from_agent IN (SELECT DISTINCT a.agentid FROM agents a WHERE a.id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM `agents_queues` aq WHERE  queue_id = f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue)))
    GROUP BY from_agent) outcall
    ON oc.agentid = outcall.agentid

FROM (
SELECT incall.name_o  AS e , (IFNULL(incall.duration,0) + IFNULL(outcall.duration,0)) AS duraton
FROM (
SELECT
  to_agent AS name_o,
  SUM(recordings.duration) AS duration
FROM
  recordings
  JOIN `profiles` p
    ON `recordings`.`to_profile_id` = p.id
WHERE date_created_ts >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
  AND recordings.server_id = '101'
  AND f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) = queue_id 
  AND to_profile_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY to_agent) incall

 LEFT  JOIN (SELECT
     from_agent AS name_o,
  SUM(recordings.duration) AS duration
    FROM
      recordings
      JOIN `profiles` p
    ON `recordings`.`to_profile_id` = p.id
    WHERE date_created_ts >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
      AND recordings.server_id = '101'
      AND call_direction = 'OUT'
      AND trunk_id IS NOT NULL
      AND from_profile_id IS NOT NULL
      AND from_agent IN (SELECT DISTINCT a.agentid FROM agents a WHERE a.id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM `agents_queues` aq WHERE  f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) = aq.queue_id ))
    GROUP BY from_agent)outcall

   UNION 
   SELECT outcall.name_o AS e  , (IFNULL(incall.duration,0) + IFNULL(outcall.duration,0)) AS duration
FROM (
SELECT
  to_agent AS name_o,
  SUM(recordings.duration) AS duration
FROM
  recordings
  JOIN `profiles` p
    ON `recordings`.`to_profile_id` = p.id
WHERE date_created_ts >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
  AND recordings.server_id = '101'
  AND f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) = queue_id 
  AND to_profile_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY to_agent) incall

 RIGHT   JOIN (SELECT
     from_agent AS name_o,
  SUM(recordings.duration) AS duration
    FROM
      recordings
      JOIN `profiles` p
    ON `recordings`.`to_profile_id` = p.id
    WHERE date_created_ts >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
      AND recordings.server_id = '101'
      AND call_direction = 'OUT'
      AND trunk_id IS NOT NULL

      AND from_agent IN (SELECT DISTINCT a.agentid FROM agents a WHERE a.id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM `agents_queues` aq WHERE  f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) = aq.queue_id ))
    GROUP BY from_agent)outcall
     ON incall.name_o = outcall.name_o
     WHERE outcall.name_o IS NOT NULL )e
     LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS t , al.`agent` FROM agent_logs al WHERE al.`time` > DATE(NOW()) AND al.`action_type` = 'miss' GROUP BY al.`agent`) al
     ON e.e = al.`agent`
     JOIN agents a ON e.e = a.`agentid` 
     JOIN `profiles` p ON a.`profile_id` = p.`id`
	UNION 	
     
     SELECT CONCAT(p.first_name, ' ', p.`last_name`) AS "کارشناس",SEC_TO_TIME(cast(e.duraton As integer)) AS "زمان پاسخگویی",IFNULL(al.t,0) AS miss
FROM (
SELECT incall.name_o  AS e , (IFNULL(incall.duration,0) + IFNULL(outcall.duration,0)) AS duraton
FROM (
SELECT
  to_agent AS name_o,
  SUM(recordings.duration) AS duration
FROM
  recordings
  JOIN `profiles` p
    ON `recordings`.`to_profile_id` = p.id
WHERE date_created_ts >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
  AND recordings.server_id = '101'
  AND f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) = queue_id 
  AND to_profile_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY to_agent) incall

 LEFT  JOIN (SELECT
     from_agent AS name_o,
  SUM(recordings.duration) AS duration
    FROM
      recordings
      JOIN `profiles` p
    ON `recordings`.`to_profile_id` = p.id
    WHERE date_created_ts >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
      AND recordings.server_id = '101'
      AND call_direction = 'OUT'
      AND trunk_id IS NOT NULL
      AND from_profile_id IS NOT NULL
      AND from_agent IN (SELECT DISTINCT a.agentid FROM agents a WHERE a.id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM `agents_queues` aq WHERE  f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) = aq.queue_id ))
    GROUP BY from_agent)outcall
     ON incall.name_o = outcall.name_o
     WHERE incall.name_o IS NOT NULL 
   UNION 
   SELECT outcall.name_o AS e  , (IFNULL(incall.duration,0) + IFNULL(outcall.duration,0)) AS duration
FROM (
SELECT
  to_agent AS name_o,
  SUM(recordings.duration) AS duration
FROM
  recordings
  JOIN `profiles` p
    ON `recordings`.`to_profile_id` = p.id
WHERE date_created_ts >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')
  AND recordings.server_id = '101'
  AND f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) = queue_id 
  AND to_profile_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY to_agent) incall

 RIGHT   JOIN (SELECT
     from_agent AS name_o,
  SUM(recordings.duration) AS duration
    FROM
      recordings
      JOIN `profiles` p
    ON `recordings`.`to_profile_id` = p.id
    WHERE date_created_ts >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y/%m/%d')

    GROUP BY from_agent)outcall

     ON e.e = al.`agent`
     JOIN agents a ON e.e = a.`agentid` 
     JOIN `profiles` p ON a.`profile_id` = p.`id`

SELECT 
     count( CASE WHEN f_miss_call(r.date_start_ts, r.date_created_ts, r.caller_id)=3 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END )
  FROM recordings r
 WHERE r.date_created_ts >= DATE(NOW())
   AND r.date_created_ts < NOW()
  AND f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) = queue_id

SELECT IFNULL((SELECT 
      COUNT(CASE WHEN f_miss_call(r.date_start_ts, r.date_created_ts, r.caller_id)=2 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) 
  FROM recordings r
 WHERE r.date_created_ts >= DATE(NOW())
   AND r.date_created_ts < NOW()
  AND (f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) IN ( queue_id ))
   AND (r.to_agent IS NULL)),0)/
IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tgui.recordings t WHERE t.`date_created_ts` >= DATE(NOW()) 
/*AND t.`call_direction` = 'IN'*/ AND (f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) IN ( queue_id ))),1) *100 AS 'abandoned',IFNULL((SELECT 
      COUNT(CASE WHEN f_miss_call(r.date_start_ts, r.date_created_ts, r.caller_id)=2 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END ) 
  FROM recordings r
 WHERE r.date_created_ts >= DATE(NOW())
   AND r.date_created_ts < NOW()
  AND (f_queue_get_by_extnumber($queue) IN ( queue_id ))
   AND (r.to_agent IS NULL) /*SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tgui.recordings t WHERE t.`date_created_ts` >= DATE(NOW()) 
 AND ($queue IN ( queue_id ) ) AND t.to_profile_id IS  NULL*/),0) AS COUNT

SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT('queue=','"',q.ext_number,'"','queue_name=','"',q.name,'"') FROM `queues` q JOIN `departments` d ON q.`department_id` = d.`id` JOIN `profiles` p 
ON d.`id` = p.`department_id` LEFT JOIN `users` u ON p.`id` = u.`profile_id` WHERE  '${__user.login}' = u.`username` OR 1<=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `users` u JOIN `groups_users` gu ON u.`id` = gu.user_id 
JOIN `groups_special_permissions` gsp ON gu.group_id = gsp.group_id  JOIN `special_permissions` sp 
ON gsp.special_permission_id = sp.id WHERE  '${__user.login}' = u.`username`  AND sp.name = 'Agent Supervisor')
